reasoning: A universally recognized icon showing a speaker with sound waves crossed out by a diagonal slash, meaning mute, silence, or no audio. It fits a focused set of tasks around muting notifications, troubleshooting missing sound, stripping audio from media, and soundproofing or quieting noisy household items. It should be distinguished from unslashed speaker icons (audio/speakers in general) and muted microphone icons (voice input).
